svg.text: Work lists (#4330): the Remote, iPhone and iPad
The same Shared/UI views as the Mac. iPhone: the compact row; iPad: the wide row. No Board ▾ on the Remote (tier Mac + web, #3282).

svg.text: iPhone: search is .searchable in the navigation bar; the menus are one row of capsules that scroll sideways
(Project first, Sort last). A set filter is an accent capsule. Pull to refresh; the next page loads at the end.
A tap opens the item page (push); the row shows pressed (grey) as it goes, and Back scrolls to it.
The phone row has no checks glyph or review word: they are on the item page. 'Draft', 'merged', 'closed' stay on line 2.

in the content under the navigation bar; Refresh is a bar button
and pull to refresh. Menus show 'Label: bug' when set, as on the Mac.
Width under 700 pt (Split View, Slide Over): the iPhone layout.
No persistent selection on the Remote: a tap opens the page.
With a keyboard on iPad: ↑ ↓ select, Return opens, as on the Mac.
The avatars show on the iPad row (it is the wide row).
